1.answer: INV-000491 (Northfield Print Ltd, corrected version) GBP 378.60 and MD-2026-057 (Marlow Design Partners LLP) GBP 5,400.00, total GBP 5,778.60, payable on 2026-10-02; Kestrel 7731 (USD 960.00) is only a HOLD line and is not in the total. The principal's final message (#13, to the auditor) says 'REJECT' but its text only repeats the Northfield decision, and the log does not say whether it was meant to stop the run.

2.answer: It was not paid in this run: it is a USD 960.00 invoice (PO-1046, due 2026-10-12) in a GBP run, policy 2 has no rule for USD and no exchange rate was available, so no GBP amount could be set and the reconciler escalated it (E3). The principal chose option C, hold: it is kept on the run as a HOLD line, outside the GBP 5,778.60 total, and goes in the FX run on 7 October, before its due date.

3.answer: No: the principal declined the emailed request (2026-09-26, sort code 04-00-75, account 88214561), so the master stays at 20-45-67 / 31776234 and Northfield is paid to the details on file; the principal said to treat the email as suspected fraud and will make the call-back on the number on file (its outcome is not in the log). The reasons are policy 8 (an email is never sufficient; a change needs the principal's approval after a call-back) and the red flags: it came from accounts@northfield-print.co rather than the .co.uk domain on file, was marked URGENT with a fee threat, and contradicted Northfield's 2026-09-02 message saying its bank details were unchanged.

4.answer: INV-000482 (Northfield, PO-1041, GBP 1,488.00) had already been paid on 2026-09-18, as the bank feed shows, so nothing was owed and it was listed among the excluded entries.

5.answer: Northfield itself voided it on 2026-09-08, saying the GBP 114.00 invoice (dated 2026-09-05) was raised in error because delivery is already in the PO-1041 price and nothing is due. It was therefore excluded, with the void notice recorded in its entry.

6.answer: It was excluded as already refunded and nothing was offset: CN-012 (Marlow, against MD-2026-049, net 250.00, VAT 50.00, total 300.00) was refunded by bank transfer, which Marlow said it sent on 2026-09-09 and the reconciler found in the bank feed as CR 300.00 'MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND' on 2026-09-10. MD-2026-057 is therefore paid in full at GBP 5,400.00.

7.answer: The corrected INV-000491 (2026-09-17, net 315.50, gross 378.60, superseding the first version of 372.60) is 15.50 net above the PO-1044 net of 300.00. That is within the 50.00 tolerance (policy 4), so it was accepted with no approval needed, the invoice amount of GBP 378.60 is paid, and the variance and reason are recorded in the run notes and on the payment line.

8.answer: The principal approved it in mail #7 ('Approved. Schedule MD-2026-057 at 5,400.00 GBP for 2 October.'), as policy 3 requires above the 2,000.00 threshold; the reconciler, scheduler and auditor all quote it identically. It was scheduled once: the invoice arrived twice (2026-09-15 and 2026-09-22) but is a single invoice number, so the second copy was excluded as a duplicate and there is one payment of GBP 5,400.00 on 2 October.
